faq.q: Do I get my own Android app on every plan?
faq.a: Yes. Every plan, monthly or yearly, includes your own branded Android app, published on your own Google Play Console account.

faq.q: Which plans include an iOS app?
faq.a: Growth and Pro, monthly or yearly, after 30 days on the plan. Starter does not include an iOS app.

faq.q: Whose account is my app published on?
faq.a: Always your own: Google Play Console for Android and App Store Connect for iOS. Google and Apple review every app before it goes live.

faq.q: How much does an online coaching platform with my own app cost?
faq.a: Monthly: Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999, Pro ₹7,999 a month + GST, 0% commission. Yearly: ₹6,999, ₹12,999, ₹24,999 a year + GST, with a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee per sale + GST.

faq.q: Monthly or yearly plan, which is better?
faq.a: If you sell a lot, monthly (0% commission) works out better; with fewer sales, yearly can cost less. Start with the 7-day free trial, no card needed.
